names.name: Pearl Trefoil
names.note: Common trefoil with white pearl-like leaf spot; no further description.

cul:313-pearl-trefoil.text: IT differs not from the common sort, save only in this particular, it hath a white spot in the leaf like a pearl. It is particularly under the dominion of the Moon, and its icon shews that it is of a singular virtue against the pearl, or pin and web in the eyes.
